item.content:encoded:
Wyatt Langford convirtió un elevado sacrificio de rutina en una de las jugadas más espectaculares de la temporada de los Rangers.
Con Langford en tercera base, Evan Carter conectó un elevado al jardín central. Langford hizo el pisa y corre y aceleró hacia el home mientras el lanzamiento obligaba al catcher Alejandro Kirk a colocarse directamente en su camino.
Entonces, Langford decidió saltar.
La estrella de los Rangers pasó por encima de Kirk, aterrizó más allá del plato y rápidamente regresó para tocar el home y anotar la carrera.
La increíble jugada ayudó a Texas a conseguir una victoria 6-2 ante Toronto y quedar como único líder de la División Oeste de la Liga Americana, a una semana del final de la temporada regular.

item.content:encoded:
With the Texas Rangers pushing toward the postseason, Langford turned a routine sacrifice fly into one of the wildest plays of their season Saturday night, hurdling Toronto Blue Jays catcher Alejandro Kirk before scrambling back to touch home plate. Texas defeated Toronto 6-2 at Globe Life Field, a victory that moved the Rangers into sole possession of first place in the American League West with one week remaining in the regular season. And the decisive moment came with Langford literally leaping over an obstacle in the sixth inning. Langford was standing at third base when Evan Carter lifted a fly ball to center field. As the ball traveled toward Brett Bateman, Langford tagged and took off for home. Bateman's throw arrived slightly up the line, forcing Kirk to move into Langford's path. So Langford jumped.

item.dc:creator: RotoWire Staff
item.description: Wyatt Langford News: On base three times in win Langford went 1-for-2 with two walks, an RBI, a stolen base and two runs scored in Saturday's 6-2 win over Toronto. Langford has been an on-base machine for Texas over the last week, reaching base safely in all five plate appearances Friday. He's drawn walks and scored runs in four consecutive games. Over the last eight contests, Langford is 7-for-25 with eight walks (.455 OBP), two steals, two doubles, one home run, four RBI and seven runs scored.

item.content:encoded:
홈 플레이트에서의 승부는 언제나 흥미진진합니다. 하지만 그 플레이가 a) 보기 드문 명장면이고 b) 상징적인 의미까지 담고 있을 때는 그야말로 특별한 짜릿함을 선사합니다.
와이엇 랭포드가 19일 밤(미국 현지시간) 글로브 라이프 필드에서 열린 블루제이스와의 경기에서 바로 그러한 명장면을 연출하며 텍사스의 6대2 승리에 기여했습니다.
6회말 에반 카터가 날린 중견수 뜬공 때 3루에서 태그업한 랭포드는 홈을 향해 전력 질주했습니다. 블루제이스의 중견수 브렛 베이트먼의 송구가 홈 플레이트 쪽으로 다소 치우치게 날아오면서, 토론토의 포수 알레한드로 커크가 랭포드의 진로를 가로막는 위치로 이동했습니다.
그러자 랭포드는 그의 위로 뛰어넘는 '허들(hurdle)' 동작을 선보였습니다.
유일한 문제는 랭포드가 다시 땅으로 내려왔을 때 홈 플레이트를 밟지 않고 지나쳐버렸다는 점이었습니다. 송구가 커크 뒤로 빠졌기 때문에 평소라면 큰 문제가 되지 않았을 상황이었습니다.
하지만 변수가 있었습니다. 투수 폴 시월드가 백업을 위해 홈 뒤로 와 있었고, 시월드에게는 랭포드가 다시 몸을 돌려 홈을 찍기 전에 태그할 수 있는 확실한 기회가 주어졌습니다. 하지만 랭포드는 시월드가 자신에게 도달하기 전에 재빨리 홈 플레이트를 터치하며 텍사스의 이날 경기 6번째 득점을 올렸습니다.
랭포드는 레인저스 스포츠 네트워크와의 인터뷰에서 "그냥 고개를 숙이고 달렸습니다"라며, "상대 포수가 베이스라인 쪽에 위치하게 되었습니다. 그냥 모든 일이 순식간에 벌어졌습니다. 사실 그렇게 뛰어넘을 계획은 전혀 없었습니다"라고 당시 상황을 설명했습니다.
랭포드의 이 놀라운 도약은 토요일 승리를 통해 레인저스가 팀 전체로서 이뤄낸 성과를 완벽하게 상징하는 명장면이 되었습니다. 텍사스는 정규시즌 마감을 단 일주일 앞두고, 텍사스주의 라이벌인 휴스턴을 뛰어넘어 아메리칸리그 서부 지구 단독 선두 자리로 도약했습니다.

item.content:encoded:
ARLINGTON, Texas (AP) — Corey Seager had an RBI double in a four-run second inning fueled by a throwing error, and the Texas Rangers beat the Toronto Blue Jays 7-1 on Friday night in the opener of a series matching AL playoff chasers.
The Rangers (77-77) reached .500 for a majors-leading 23rd time and pulled within one game of the White Sox for the third and final AL wild-card spot, although Chicago has the tiebreaker. The defending AL champion Blue Jays (76-78) are two games back in the wild-card race.
Texas also closed the gap on Houston by pulling even with the Astros atop the AL West, but the Rangers would have to win the division outright to finish ahead of their in-state rival. Houston lost to Atlanta 6-2.
The Rangers took the lead in the second on Evan Carter's bases-loaded grounder that scored Wyatt Langford, and Jake Burger also came home when shortstop Ernie Clement's throw trying to force him out at third bounced wide of the bag into foul territory. Seager made it 4-0 with his double.
Dylan Cease (11-6) walked a season-high six among his first 15 batters and was replaced with two outs in the third after throwing 38 balls and 36 strikes.
Six of the Texas runs were unearned as the Blue Jays walked 10 and had three throwing errors, two by third baseman Kazuma Okamoto.
Trevor Williams (2-0) finished with four scoreless innings after starter Kumar Rocker took a 4-0 lead into the fifth but couldn't finish and was replaced by Tyler Alexander.
Toronto's Nathan Lukes had the longest active hitting streak in the majors stopped at 13 games when he was replaced by pinch-hitter Davis Schneider in the fifth. Lukes was 0 for 2 with a deep liner that Carter, the center fielder, ran down at the wall in right center.
Up next
Blue Jays RHP José Soriano (12-7, 3.56 ERA) is set to face Texas RHP Cal Quantrill (9-5, 2.90) on Saturday.
